name: センサーパターンノイズ (PRNU)
description: 検出します フォトレスポンス非均一性 - a unique fingerprint left by each camera sensor. AI images lack this hardware-based identifier, making it a strong フォレンジック signal.
algorithm: フォトレスポンス非均一性 (PRNU) Sensor Noise Fingerprint
mechanism: 抽出します unique sensor noise fingerprint from the image. Every camera sensor has unique fixed-パターン noise. AI生成の images lack any authentic PRNU パターン.
parameters: Denoising: BM3D / ウェーブレット, Correlation: normalized cross-相関, 閾値: Neyman-Pearson
accuracy: ブラウザ内では低い - 55-65%（参照センサーなし）
source: Lukas et al. (2006), SPIE Image and Video Communications
useCase: Detecting absence of physical sensor noise fingerprint in AI生成の images

references.title: Lukas, J. et al. (2006). Digital Camera Identification from Sensor Pattern Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Chen, M. et al. (2008). Determining Image Origin and Integrity Using Sensor Noise. IEEE TIFS.
Goljan, M. et al. (2009). Large Scale Test of Sensor Fingerprint Camera Identification. SPIE.

strengths:
• Based on unique hardware sensor property
• Extremely difficult to forge sensor noise
• Well-established フォレンジック standard
• Can identify specific camera unit
limitations:
• Browser implementation has reduced 精度
• Requires reference sensor fingerprint for best results
• Heavy processing/compression destroys PRNU
• Large flat images provide better estimates
